almanac.pvz.pvz:cabbage_pult: Cast cabbages at enemies to attack.
almanac.pvz.pvz:chomper: Swallow enemies approaching and then chew for a few seconds to heal itself. When sculkificated, Chompers sense vibrations nearby and trace enemies.
almanac.pvz.pvz:dandelion: Launch slow-floating seed bombs that bombard zombies within a range and let them spread effects they carry like Creepers do.
almanac.pvz.pvz:dandelion.special: Wish that everyone is loved by and then love life. In remembrance of @蒲公英の心吹到天涯.
almanac.pvz.pvz:gatling_pea: Shoot four peas at a time. When controlled by a player, Gatling Peas can stay shooting until it's overheated.
almanac.pvz.pvz:gold_bloom: Immediately generate a huge amount of sun.
almanac.pvz.pvz:hypno_shroom: Drive the enemy who eat it fight for you.
almanac.pvz.pvz:iceberg_lettuce:
Freeze a zombie for a few seconds.
§lNOTE§r   Lettuce and cabbage are in different biological families. Crafting table of the mod doesn't reflect actual relation of the plants.
almanac.pvz.pvz:jalapeno: Shoot angry and spicy Angers at four directions.
almanac.pvz.pvz:kernel_pult: Cast kernels, and cast butter that can cover enemy's view at a chance.
almanac.pvz.pvz:marigold: Offer you some treasure each time you fertilize it.
almanac.pvz.pvz:melon_pult: Cast high-damage melons with splash damage at zombies.
almanac.pvz.pvz:pea_shooter: Shoot peas at enemies to attack. Your first line of defence.
almanac.pvz.pvz:plantern: Dispel fog nearby and removes dark effect of its teammates.
almanac.pvz.pvz:potato_mine: Explode when touching an enemy, but needs short preparation. Invisible to enemies when finished preparation.
almanac.pvz.pvz:pumpkin: Can plant on other plants and protect plants inside, but more combustible than other plants.
almanac.pvz.pvz:repeater: Shoot two peas at a time to attack.
almanac.pvz.pvz:snow_pea: Shoot snow peas that can freeze zombies.
almanac.pvz.pvz:split_pea: Shoot peas at two directions and attack different enemies.
almanac.pvz.pvz:starfruit: Shoot stars at five directions that rebound when hitting a wall.
almanac.pvz.pvz:sun_flower: Produces sun and provides max sun limit, but requires enough day light or ambient light.
almanac.pvz.pvz:tall_nut: Has almost unbreakable health and armor, but more combustible than other plants.
almanac.pvz.pvz:tangle_kelp: Drag into the water and constantly hurt enemies it touch.
almanac.pvz.pvz:torch_wood: Lit and strengthen peas fly through.
almanac.pvz.pvz:umbrella_leaf: Bounce away enemies, their projectiles that is approaching, and friendly players crouching.
almanac.pvz.pvz:veloci_radish: Gathers into a team, chase and attack enemies.
almanac.pvz.pvz:wall_nut: Has tough armor, but more combustible than other plants.
